title: Rentals Settlement Note: Ended-Rental Holdback on Driver Hold-Release Payouts
content:
When a payout hold on a **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** earnings account is lifted, an ended-rental holdback is kept back from the hold-release payout. It follows the status of the driver's rental under **Wayfare Rentals (driver vehicle rentals)**, read from the rental's status, its balance due and the security deposit it still holds:

- a rental that has been returned and is not yet closed holds back its balance due less the security deposit still held, never below zero;
- a rental whose return is due holds back its whole balance due;
- an active rental, a closed rental or no rental holds back nothing.

The holdback is taken off the available balance when the hold is lifted, in the one deduction made for whatever is kept back from that payout and before the payout is rounded; the amount kept back stays in the available balance and is paid with the next scheduled weekly payout.

## Status table

| Wayfare Rentals rental status | Ended-rental holdback |
|---|---|
| Returned, not yet closed | Balance due less security deposit still held; 0.00 if the deposit covers the balance |
| Return due | The whole balance due (the deposit is not netted) |
| Active | Nothing |
| Closed | Nothing |
| No rental | Nothing |

## Hypothetical rentals

| Rental | Balance due | Deposit still held | Holdback |
|---|---|---|---|
| Returned, not closed | 420.00 | 250.00 | 170.00 |
| Returned, not closed | 180.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |
| Return due | 420.00 | 250.00 | 420.00 |
| Active | 95.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 |
